fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects calls to "LoadAssemblyFromPath" or "LoadAssemblyFromNS" that are part of the "CL_LoadAssembly.ps1" script. This can be abused to load different assemblies and bypass App locker controls.
fields.name: Assembly Loading Via CL_LoadAssembly.ps1
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "LoadAssemblyFromPath " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "LoadAssemblyFromNS "))
